stories.s: A game of rock, paper, scissors is used to determine when the elite female and male races will take place at next year's two-day London Marathon.

stories.t: Couple describes relief at rescue after whale destroys their yacht
stories.s: Jeremy and Jemma Cooper were 500 miles off the coast of New Zealand when their yacht, the Tai Tam, collided with a sperm whale.

stories.t: Luxury prison in Indonesia demolished after public outcry
stories.s: Indonesian lawmakers on Wednesday ordered the demolition of a controversial luxury compound inside a penitentiary near the capital.

stories.s: In the emotional letter, the judge describes the survivor as "the bravest little girl this court has ever seen".

stories.t: The U.S. military withdraws from Iraq over 2 decades after its invasion
stories.s: 23 years after the United States military invaded Iraq, sparking an insurgency and a civil war, the U.S. has withdrawn its forces, as the country still tries to combat Iranian influence.

stories.t: Retired general who led troops in Iraq warns U.S. exit may give Iran, ISIS an opening
stories.s: Retired Lt. Gen. H.R. McMaster, who commanded U.S. troops in Iraq, says the withdrawal could strengthen Iran and leave Iraq more vulnerable to ISIS.
